amendment.interface_basis: Actual installed binary usage supports --focus-body-index. The renderer source SHA in v1 requires NHBONES1 ABI 2 and NHSKIN1 ABI 4; all arms use the same ABI2 diagnostic geometry projection, and the skin arm adds the unchanged ABI4 diagnostic shell paired by the unchanged registration fingerprint.
amendment.no_change: No source pose, geometry, registration, camera, threshold, skin weights, or prediction changed. v1 and v2 plans and failures remain retained.

payload_adapter.operation: strip only the ABI3 trailing source_record_index field from each bone record and set the ABI field to 2 for the installed renderer; preserve every leading body/geometry/stable-id/local-pose field and exact vertex/normal/index streams, registration fingerprint, and source archive hash.
payload_adapter.scope: diagnostic compatibility projection only; it does not alter source evidence or qualify an ABI3/ABI5 runtime.

amendment.prior_attempt_status: v2 failed before render at input validation: installed binary accepts NHBONES1 ABI 2, candidate geometry payload was ABI 3.

analysis: Compare source geometry receipt to native owner outputs and inspect each retained side frame. This is a one-subject visual diagnostic, not a population estimate, clinical validation, loaded mechanics result or ABI5 runtime qualification. A deterministic, byte-verified ABI2 projection feeds this installed visual-only renderer; the ABI3 candidate remains the source-authoritative geometry payload.
device: Record the actual Metal pose and renderer device from each native summary; no device name is assumed in advance.

experimental_units_and_conditions.arms: bone_anatomy shows registered patella, femur and tibia; skin_shell shows the same source pose with only the top-four diagnostic shell selected by the ABI4 renderer
experimental_units_and_conditions.camera: side view, camera index 2, 512 px; focus patella source body using installed --focus-body-index default framing distance
experimental_units_and_conditions.pose: literal source qpos0, no trajectory or force input
experimental_units_and_conditions.retries: none; preserve any failure as inconclusive

model_and_mechanism.renderer_abi_limit: This local renderer accepts ABI 4 and does not accept the ABI 5 full-weight payload. The ABI 4 input is an explicit top-four diagnostic projection, not the ABI 5 candidate.

prediction_and_refutation.native_visibility: Each bone-only output reports the three requested source-bone surfaces; each diagnostic skin output reports one shell and more than zero skin-shell pixels.
prediction_and_refutation.refutation: The source offset is below 0.025 m on either side, a requested bone surface is absent, or either skin-shell output has zero skin-shell pixels. A native command/load failure is inconclusive, not a pass.
prediction_and_refutation.source_metric: minimum literal-qpos0 patella-body-center anteriority to the pinned source knee-anchor plane is at least 0.025 m on each side.

question: Does the current equality-neutral source pose place each BodyParts3D patella anterior to the source knee-anchor plane, and does the native ABI4 diagnostic shell still present a coherent outer knee contour around it?
stopping_rule: Run the four planned one-frame outputs once in order, stopping at the first invalid or failed arm. No retries or camera adjustment.
